_help: Act 8, the desert route (event temple_battle): the old temple again, and he is waiting there; after this talk, the temple fight (fight_at_temple). With temple_studied, the Egyptologist knows the building (temple_known: act8.gd can open the side passage). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act89.py.

again.speaker: player
again.line: The temple of the three gods, the same columns as before. This time the sand around it is full of footprints that don't come from horses.

first.speaker: player
first.line: The old temple on the desert road, three gods at its gate. We never stopped here on the way out. The sand around it is full of footprints that don't come from horses.

k_eleanor.speaker: eleanor
k_eleanor.line: There's a passage behind the second shrine. I sketched it, remember? If we have to fall back, we fall back there.

k_pembroke.speaker: pembroke
k_pembroke.line: My survey shows a corridor behind the sanctuary. One way in, one way out. Defensible.

k_hassan.speaker: hassan
k_hassan.line: Behind the sanctuary, the priests' stair. We can hold it, if we must.

r_hargreaves.speaker: hargreaves
r_hargreaves.line: Horses inside the outer court. Rifles on the pylon. Make him come to us.

r_youssef.speaker: youssef
r_youssef.line: The horses are screaming. They know. They know before we do.

come.speaker: player
come.line: Between the columns, something in bronze bands steps out of the dark, and the horses break.
